stemMd: Choose the version that correctly completes the paired construction: "The workshop offers not only lectures ___ practical demonstrations."
explanationMd: The paired conjunction "not only ... but also" adds a second benefit. It correctly relates lectures and practical demonstrations as two workshop offerings.

distractorRationale.c: Not only conventionally pairs with but also in this additive construction.
distractorRationale.b: This does not complete the additive not only construction.
distractorRationale.d: This changes addition into substitution and does not complete the pair.
